ends.note: south end of the short unnamed alley (about 6 ft, printed ALL[EY]) that runs south from South East Pearl and stops at a building

notes: Sycamore on the west (faces x 1078 and 1310), Broadway on the east (100 ft, faces about 2717 and 3064, drifting a little west going south). Between Sycamore and Broadway, Pearl is a single wide space with the Pearl Street Market house down its middle (market from x 1312 to 2712, y 2186 to 2342, sheds to y 2390); the roadway north of it is printed N.E. PEARL (58') and the one south of it S.E. PEARL (94'), recorded as North East Pearl Street and South East Pearl Street, each ending at Sycamore and Broadway (T). The single E. Pearl coming in from the west (sheet 113; faces y 2075 and 2368 here) ends at Sycamore between them, and the E. Pearl leaving east of Broadway (sheet 105; 66 ft, faces y 2385 and 2610) is offset about 64 px south of South East Pearl, so Broadway has two T points on its south-Pearl side. Holmes Alley (printed HOLMES ALLEY, 10 ft between faces) runs from Sycamore to Broadway and ends at both. Spencer Alley (10', not named on this sheet, named on sheet 104) runs from Holmes Alley south across E. 2nd; its centre shifts from x 2372 north of 2nd to 2357 south of it, so the 2nd St crossing is averaged. An unnamed 10' alley runs from Holmes Alley to E. 2nd at x 1563 (printed 10' at both ends). A short unnamed alley about 6 ft wide runs south from South East Pearl at x 2385 and dead-ends about 125 ft in.
